unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Architected a governed, policy-gated agent execution surface for enterprise AI workflows, defining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths for regulated deployments.
- bul_unify_002: Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, pairing partner deal support with usage-based subscription forecasting to expand recurring revenue.
- bul_unify_003: Established audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows through context engineering and runtime resilience controls governing evaluation gates and rollback.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the production adoption lifecycle for client AI systems, compressing the lab-to-production cycle from six months to three weeks through replayable runtime design and exit disposition governance.
- bul_unify_005: Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse and cloud data pipelines with dense sparse exact retrieval design.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability, applying an operating model for agentic AI to convert bespoke delivery into productized IP.

narrative_sentence: Owned Unify Consulting's mandate to industrialize governed agentic AI, connecting platform direction, control-plane architecture, a commercial model built around reusable IP, and partner-channel enablement to repeatable commercial deployment and sustained adoption across regulated enterprise clients.

selected_fact_plan.synthesis_basis: Higher-level thesis connecting platform architecture, distributed infrastructure, commercialization, lifecycle standardization, and runtime governance.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Owned the industrialization of governed agentic AI through platform architecture and controlled enterprise deployment.
Connected reusable IP commercialization and partner-supported adoption to regulated enterprise deployment.

selected_briefing_themes: turning platform capability into repeatable enterprise value
converting field learning into scalable assets
balancing partner scale with technical quality and trust
jd_alignment.targeting_rationale: The narrative emphasizes architecture, commercialization, reusable IP, partner enablement, and regulated enterprise adoption because these themes align the Unify evidence to the target role without using targeting materials as proof.

change_log.change: Synthesized the finalized bullet themes into one higher-level role thesis without repeating bullet metrics or four-word companion phrases.
